findings: index.html:45-65 — Nav icons (🏠💵📋🛒🔔📊) lack aria-hidden="true". These emojis are decorative inside buttons that already have visible text labels, but screen readers will announce them (e.g. "Home House").
app.js:251 — account-rename-btn uses title="Rename" but no aria-label; title is not reliably accessible on touch devices.
app.js:654,691,808,880,941 — Delete buttons (✕) use title="Delete" but no aria-label; title alone is insufficient for accessible name.
app.js:690,807,940 — Edit buttons (✎) use title="Edit" but no aria-label; same issue as delete buttons.
app.js:975-1020 — openModal() does not move focus into the modal on open, does not implement focus trap, and does not return focus to trigger on close.
app.js:1022-1026 — closeModal() clears content but does not restore focus to the element that opened the modal.
styles.css:884-888 — .bill-due (overdue bills) uses red text color (#f87171) alone with no icon or text alternative; colorblind users cannot distinguish overdue status.
app.js:647,868 — Overdue bill due-dates render with class="bill-due" (red color only) without supplementary text/icon like "OVERDUE" label or warning symbol.
styles.css:117 — html { font-size: 16px } sets a fixed base size that overrides the user's browser text-size preference, hindering dynamic type support.
styles.css:118 — -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100% prevents iOS Dynamic Type from scaling text, overriding user font-size settings.
styles.css:1191 — .nav-label and .tab-label have min-height: 44px but are forced to display:flex with center alignment, which can cause touch-target overlap issues on small screens.
app.js:700,817,889 — getMainContent().innerHTML replaces entire DOM on every render; focus is lost on each re-render (e.g. after adding/deleting items) with no focus restoration.
motion.css:20-54 — prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is implemented and disables animations/transitions. Good.
styles.css:1736-1740 — :focus-visible provides visible focus ring for keyboard users. Good.
app.js:302-305,339-341,1055-1064,1171-1190,1293-1312 — All modal form inputs have associated <label> elements with matching for/id attributes. Good.
